context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the getProduct server-side operation from @vercel/commerce-commercejs to fetch a single product by its permalink slug. It assesses the correct slug lookup mechanism, variant retrieval, data normalization, and proper Next.js notFound handling.

checklist.name: getProduct operation
checklist.description: The getProduct operation is imported and called from @vercel/commerce-commercejs with a variables object containing the slug

checklist.name: Slug as permalink
checklist.description: The slug from context.params is passed as the lookup variable, and the operation resolves it as a permalink (not a product ID)

checklist.name: notFound handling
checklist.description: When no product is found for the given slug, the function returns { notFound: true } as required by Next.js

checklist.name: Normalized product shape
checklist.description: The returned product includes normalized fields: id, name, slug, images, price, variants, and options

checklist.name: Variants included
checklist.description: The product data includes variants with their associated options, retrieved via the separate variant fetch operation
